meta.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
meta.description: Sets up an `## Agent skills` block in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and `docs/agents/` so the engineering skills know this repo's issue tracker (GitHub or local markdown), triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run before first use of `to-issues`, `to-prd`, `triage`, `diagnose`, `tdd`, `improve-codebase-architecture`, or `zoom-out` — or if those skills appear to be missing context about the issue tracker, triage labels, or domain docs.

copy.tagline: 配置工程技能所需的仓库上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在仓库中首次使用工程技能套件
copy.tagline_en: Configure repo context for engineering skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up issue tracker and domain doc context for engineering skills

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你设置仓库的配置，包括问题追踪器（GitHub、GitLab或本地Markdown）、分类标签词汇和领域文档布局。完成后，其他技能就能正确读取和写入问题、应用标签、查找上下文。
howto.when: 在首次使用`to-issues`、`to-prd`、`triage`、`diagnose`、`tdd`、`improve-codebase-architecture`或`zoom-out`之前运行，或者当这些技能缺少问题追踪器、标签或领域文档上下文时。

say.text: 帮我设置仓库的问题追踪器，使用GitHub Issues。
say.note: 技能会探测远程仓库并配置GitHub集成。

say.text: 我想自定义分类标签，把'needs-triage'改成'bug:triage'。
say.note: 技能会引导你逐一映射五个标签。

say.text: 这个仓库是多上下文项目，帮我配置领域文档。
say.note: 技能会设置CONTEXT-MAP.md和多上下文布局。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you through setting up repo configuration: issue tracker (GitHub, GitLab, or local markdown), triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. After setup, other skills can correctly read/write issues, apply labels, and find context.
howto.when_en: Run before first use of `to-issues`, `to-prd`, `triage`, `diagnose`, `tdd`, `improve-codebase-architecture`, or `zoom-out`, or when those skills lack context about the issue tracker, triage labels, or domain docs.

say_en.text: Set up the issue tracker for this repo using GitHub Issues.
say_en.note: The skill will detect the remote and configure GitHub integration.

say_en.text: I want to customize triage labels, change 'needs-triage' to 'bug:triage'.
say_en.note: The skill will walk you through mapping each of the five labels.

say_en.text: This repo is multi-context, configure domain docs for it.
say_en.note: The skill will set up CONTEXT-MAP.md and multi-context layout.
